en: Color-tinted historic street scene showing a broad avenue lined with multi‑story European-style buildings with shops and awnings. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and ride in horse‑drawn carriages. In the distance stands a domed church. Printed titles in Cyrillic and Latin identify the city as Varna and the street as Preslavska (Rue Preslavska). The card shows aging and surface wear.
